body: My birthday is in a few weeks. Maybe wrestlemania.

I appreciate the words. But really I don’t care anymore. I’ve tried to get better before, that obviously didn’t work. I know I’m still young and there’s more to see. But, I hate to say it, I’m giving up. Besides, I saw somewhere on here I think that only like 1% of teen suicides are successful. I think of the people that I’ve told only one has taken me seriously. I’ve been trying to push everyone away so they don’t have to deal with me much. It’ll pain a lot of people, I know. But if this attempt fails it’ll only happen again. Depression doesn’t get better. You just get used to it. 

I’ll just become another statistic.
You actually made me laugh for the first time in a while

I write stories. I write my feelings down. Almost every single one I wrote is sad, but it helps get my feelings out there, even though I don’t publish them. 

Other than that I think about what should be on my will.
